title: 2000 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: In \(1960\) only \(5\%\) of the working adults in Carlin City worked at home. By \(1970\) the “at-home” work force had increased to \(8\%.\) In \(1980\) there were approximately \(15\%\) working at home, and in \(1990\) there were \(30\%.\) The graph that best illustrates this is

solutions.text:
The only graph that shows all the data points is graph E .

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Match the four percentages to the four years
The plotted values should rise from about \(5\) to \(30\)
